snippet.title: Kimochii Classroom - Official Release Trailer -
snippet.description:
Download the FULL game for FREE here:
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376020/Kimochii_Classroom
- Itch.io: https://radishasmr.itch.io/kimochii-classroom

Welcome to my new game, Kimochii Classroom! A free slice-of-life visual novel with 100,000+ words, stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Filled to the brim with personality, jump into a story with a loveable cast of characters and a meticulously crafted soundscape to bring the world to life!

I hope you have a fun time playing!!! ❤️


#radishasmr #akemi #kimochiiclassroom
